dependencyNotes: Each exact model snapshot has all16acf MATLAB helper definitions and no missingacf function calls. MATLAB/Simulink built-ins are external runtime dependencies.

Frozen snapshots store helpers in a helpers directory for source archival. acf_open expects generated beside its own directory; an installed user-facing copy normally places the helpers in acf_simulink beside generated and viewer, or places generated/viewer beside an archived helper directory. This inventory preserves original source layout and makes no restructuring changes.

The accepted private layoutd HTML template is byte-identical to the canonical template, hash9e78b70729b593a3bd370de31fe23c47bdfaa765671f6666f0eaed0748b5876d. Suggested additional template placements are explicit runtime dependencies, not changes to frozen scientific manifests.

The unchanged historical aggregate reader hashes eight selected r1 worst/controller-worst native traces. The four first-native traces are optional for rerunning prefix-preparation. They are listed individually outside the default source/certificate files; no whole native-trace folder is inventoried.

Original source certificates contain absolute paths. A portable audit needs a path mapping to the suggested archive members while preserving the original certificates/hashes. A fresh physical rerun can directly use the frozen source/candidate and recipe options instead of reproducing the historical stop/resume workflow.
Two61-case JSON certificates are included only to preserve the documented122 extra execution counter. Their full trajectories/configuration/legacy sources are excluded.

The native global worst, reports/figures/offline replay, selected additional proof traces and active30s campaign results are managed separately by the root delivery task. No all-history40GB inventory is attempted.
